planSelection.title: Choose a plan for your stage
planSelection.subtitle: Whether you’re a private teacher on your own or run a large learning center - there’s a plan that brings more order, full control over cancellations and scheduling, and a calmer day-to-day.
outcomes: Less chaos between WhatsApp and the calendar
Fewer lessons falling through the cracks
More order, control, and a professional service experience
planSelection.paymentStubBody: Your payment page will be wired here later. For now you can start a free trial or continue to the final step without charging.

upgrade.a: Yes — anytime from your account. Billing updates on the next cycle.

trial.a: No charge while you try: students, lessons, and calendar at a basic level. Full automation, advanced reports, parent portal, and AI are on Growth and above.

choose.a: Starter — solo or very small ops, structure and basic reminders. Growth — steady volume, full automation, reports, parent portal, and AI. Unsure? Start free or Starter and upgrade when you’re ready.

cancel.a: Per the service terms, you manage billing from your account. Support can help with plan changes.

free.title: Free trial
free.tagline: Try the product — no charge, no card.
free.bestFor: Solo teachers evaluating Lessio before paying.
bullets: No full automation stack, advanced reports, or AI

starter.title: Starter
starter.tagline: Day-to-day order instead of WhatsApp and spreadsheets.
starter.bestFor: Private teachers or a very small operation.
bullets: Students and lessons in one place

growth.title: Growth
growth.tagline: Automation, reports, parent portal, and AI — less manual chasing.
growth.bestFor: An active workload that needs serious time savings.
bullets: AI for routine messaging and ops

center.title: Center
center.tagline: Tailored rollout, teams, integrations, and support — not “just another seat.”
center.bestFor: Learning centers, multi-teacher setups, or special requirements.
